adjudication.rationale: In db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb the migration loops through `records.each do |h|` and runs `execute "INSERT INTO embeddable_hosts (host, category_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES ('#{h}', #{category_id}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)"`. The host value `h` comes from the `site_settings` table (`embeddable_hosts`), and is directly interpolated into SQL inside single quotes with no escaping/quoting. If `h` contains a single quote (or other SQL metacharacters), the SQL will break, and it also enables SQL injection during migration if an attacker/admin-controlled setting contains crafted input. Using `quote(h)`/bind params would avoid this.
